rule: Every number comes from a {placeholder} that lib/sources.mjs fills from a committed file or from the live site at capture time. A digit typed into a caption fails web/test/film-captions.test.ts.

captions.gap-held: {gap.close} → {gap.open}. NYSE is closed, and the NVDAc price feed held one answer for {gap.hours} h.
captions.gap-swaps: Its Aerodrome pool on Base kept trading: {gap.swaps} swaps meanwhile, up to {gap.gapBps} bps {gap.side} the frozen answer.
captions.decides-how: Claude proposes. The vault, a contract on Base, runs its checks and decides.
captions.decides-log: A refusal does not revert: the vault records a typed Decision either way, with its reason code.
captions.decides-clip: On Basescan: the vault's Decision event, with its reason code.
captions.mandate-brief: The owner's brief: a basket of NVDAc, GOOGLc and AAPLc, kept inside a mandate the vault enforces.
captions.mandate-caps: The mandate onchain: {ledger.perTrade} per trade, {ledger.perDay} a day, no stock above {ledger.weightCapPct}% of the vault.

mandate-reserve.text: Each stock is capped at {reserve.capPct}%, so buys can never take the USDC reserve below {reserve.floorPct}%.

captions.mandate-timelock: The agent cannot loosen it: every rule change waits out a public timelock.
captions.proposal-tick: Each Decision commits to its rationale's hash. The ledger hashes the text in your browser and ticks a match.
captions.proposal-clip: On Basescan, the input read as text: the rationale and its sources travel in the same transaction.
captions.proposal-verify: Or check it by hand with read-only cast commands: no wallet, no key.
captions.thanksgiving-sim: Simulated in the browser: on Thanksgiving the market-session check fails.
captions.thanksgiving-tx: On Base: the agent's own intent on Thanksgiving, refused with MARKET_CLOSED and recorded.
captions.thanksgiving-placeholder: Placeholder: the agent's Thanksgiving Decision is not on Base yet.
captions.early-sim: Simulated: on Friday, after the early close, the same check fails.
captions.early-tx: On Base: the agent's two Decisions that Friday. Allowed before the early close, refused after it.
captions.early-placeholder: Placeholder: the early-close pair is not on Base yet.
captions.brief-ask: Briefs from any wallet reach the agent through an onchain inbox. Claude reads them; the vault keeps the last word.
captions.brief-tx: On Base: an outside wallet's brief, and the vault's Decision on the agent's answer.
captions.brief-placeholder: Placeholder: no outside brief and answer on Base yet.
captions.receipts-contracts: {deployments.count} contracts on Base mainnet. On {deployments.verifiedOn}, Basescan showed each one's source as verified.
captions.receipts-ci: CI on main, {readme.ciDate}: {readme.contractTests} contract, {readme.agentTests} agent, {readme.webUnitTests} website unit and {readme.e2eTests} browser tests passed.
captions.receipts-proof: Every count on /proof has a written rule, and anyone can recount it from Base.
